specs.title: API-01 Cinemas: kiosk cinema is listed and active

annotations.description: The cinema list contains the cinema this kiosk is configured for, and it is active and priced in KWD.
The kiosk cannot start selling if its cinema is missing or inactive.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/content/cinemas -> HTTP 200 | code=10001 result=success msg="" (27 ms)

steps.title: Verify the kiosk cinema is listed, active and priced in KWD

annotations.description: The cinema list contains the cinema this kiosk is configured for, and it is active and priced in KWD.
The kiosk cannot start selling if its cinema is missing or inactive.

specs.title: API-02 Sessions: today's programme lists the movies showing

annotations.description: Today's programme loads for the kiosk cinema and contains at least one movie with a showtime. Every movie found is listed with its certification, running time, experiences, showtimes and screens.
Without the programme, customers cannot choose a film or showtime, so no tickets can be sold.

stdout.text: POST http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/content/csessions -> HTTP 200 | code=10001 result=success msg="" (136 ms)

steps.title: Verify movies with showtimes are returned

annotations.description: Today's programme loads for the kiosk cinema and contains at least one movie with a showtime. Every movie found is listed with its certification, running time, experiences, showtimes and screens.
Without the programme, customers cannot choose a film or showtime, so no tickets can be sold.

specs.title: API-03 Ticket types: an expired session is rejected

annotations.description: Asking for ticket types of a session that no longer exists returns a clear "Session has expired" answer.
A customer who waits too long on the kiosk must get a clear message instead of a crash or wrong prices.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/content/trans/tickettype?cinemaId=0000000001&sessionId=0 -> HTTP 200 | code=11001 result=dialog msg="Session has expired" (21 ms)

annotations.description: Asking for ticket types of a session that no longer exists returns a clear "Session has expired" answer.
A customer who waits too long on the kiosk must get a clear message instead of a crash or wrong prices.

specs.title: API-04 Seat layout: an expired session is rejected

annotations.description: Asking for the seat map of a session that no longer exists returns "Session has expired".
The seat screen must not show an out-of-date seat map, which could lead to double-booked seats.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/content/trans/seatlayoutkiosk?cinemaId=0000000001&sessionId=0&areacode=0 -> HTTP 200 | code=11001 result=dialog msg="Session has expired" (21 ms)

annotations.description: Asking for the seat map of a session that no longer exists returns "Session has expired".
The seat screen must not show an out-of-date seat map, which could lead to double-booked seats.

specs.title: API-05 Food menu: concession items are listed with prices

annotations.description: The food & beverage menu loads, and every item has a positive price shown in KWD.
A missing or zero price would let customers order food for free or block the food screen.

stdout.text: POST http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/content/food/getfood -> HTTP 200 | code=10001 result=success msg="" (122 ms)

steps.title: Verify every item has a positive KWD price

annotations.description: The food & beverage menu loads, and every item has a positive price shown in KWD.
A missing or zero price would let customers order food for free or block the food screen.

specs.title: API-06 Coming soon: list is returned

annotations.description: The coming-soon films list loads, even when it is empty.
The Coming Soon screen on the kiosk depends on this call.

stdout.text: POST http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/content/comingsoon -> HTTP 200 | code=10001 result= msg="This is splash text" (23 ms)

steps.title: Verify HTTP 200 with code 10001 and a list

annotations.description: The coming-soon films list loads, even when it is empty.
The Coming Soon screen on the kiosk depends on this call.

specs.title: API-07 Email domains: common domains are offered

annotations.description: The quick-pick email domains used on the kiosk keyboard load, include @gmail.com and are well formed.
Customers use these buttons to type their email faster when receiving tickets by email.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/content/email-domains -> HTTP 200 | code=10001 result=success msg="" (15 ms)

steps.title: Verify @gmail.com is offered and every domain starts with @

annotations.description: The quick-pick email domains used on the kiosk keyboard load, include @gmail.com and are well formed.
Customers use these buttons to type their email faster when receiving tickets by email.

specs.title: API-08 Club card: top-up amounts are listed in ascending KWD

annotations.description: The club card top-up amounts load as positive values in ascending order, each labelled "KWD n".
The Top Up screen shows these buttons, and a wrong label would charge a different amount than shown.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/clubcard/getamounts -> HTTP 200 | code=10001 result=success msg="" (20 ms)

steps.title: Verify amounts are positive, ascending and labelled "KWD n"

annotations.description: The club card top-up amounts load as positive values in ascending order, each labelled "KWD n".
The Top Up screen shows these buttons, and a wrong label would charge a different amount than shown.

specs.title: API-09 Pickup: an unknown booking reference is not found

annotations.description: Looking up a booking reference that does not exist returns "Booking not found".
Prevents printing tickets for a mistyped or fake booking reference on the Pickup screen.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/history/kiosk/booking?cinemaId=0000000001&bookingReference=ZZZZ0000 -> HTTP 200 | code=11001 result=error msg="Booking not found" (55 ms)

annotations.description: Looking up a booking reference that does not exist returns "Booking not found".
Prevents printing tickets for a mistyped or fake booking reference on the Pickup screen.

specs.title: API-10 KNET payment status: an unknown booking has no active booking

annotations.description: Checking KNET payment status for a booking that does not exist returns "There are no active bookings." (not 403/404).
The kiosk polls this endpoint after every card payment. The logs show thousands of 403/404 answers here.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/payment/knet/kiosk/status?trackId=0&bookingId=0 -> HTTP 200 | code=12020 result=dialog msg="There are no active bookings." (14 ms)

steps.title: Verify "There are no active bookings." is returned

annotations.description: Checking KNET payment status for a booking that does not exist returns "There are no active bookings." (not 403/404).
The kiosk polls this endpoint after every card payment. The logs show thousands of 403/404 answers here.

specs.title: API-11 Customer login: an unknown user is asked to sign up

annotations.description: Logging in with an email that has no account returns "User not found, Please signup". Uses a made-up user, so no real account is touched.
The Account screen must guide unknown customers to register instead of failing silently.

stdout.text: POST http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/customer/login -> HTTP 200 | code=12001 result=dialog msg="User not found, Please signup" (205 ms)

steps.title: Verify "User not found, Please signup" is returned

annotations.description: Logging in with an email that has no account returns "User not found, Please signup". Uses a made-up user, so no real account is touched.
The Account screen must guide unknown customers to register instead of failing silently.

specs.title: API-12 Security: requests without valid kiosk credentials are rejected

annotations.description: Kiosk-only endpoints reject a missing key, a wrong key, and a missing "platform: KIOSK" header.
Stops anyone on the network from calling kiosk payment endpoints. Also documents the 403 the real kiosks hit when the platform header is missing.

stdout.text: GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/payment/knet/kiosk/status?trackId=0&bookingId=0 -> HTTP 401 | code=12002 result=error msg="Kiosk key rejected" (18 ms)
GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/payment/knet/kiosk/status?trackId=0&bookingId=0 -> HTTP 401 | code=12002 result=error msg="Kiosk key rejected" (13 ms)
GET http://<kiosk-api-host>:8090/api/payment/knet/kiosk/status?trackId=0&bookingId=0 -> HTTP 403 | code=12002 result=error msg="This endpoint is for configured kiosks only" (19 ms)

annotations.description: Kiosk-only endpoints reject a missing key, a wrong key, and a missing "platform: KIOSK" header.
Stops anyone on the network from calling kiosk payment endpoints. Also documents the 403 the real kiosks hit when the platform header is missing.
